hints.title: Threshold Filtering
hints.text: Compare each employee work duration against the required target hours.

hints.title: Counting Matches
hints.text: Increment a counter whenever an employee hours are greater than or equal to target.

hints.title: Return Value
hints.text: Return the total number of qualified employees after iterating through the array.

hints.title: Implementation

complexity.notes: Single pass counting elements meeting or exceeding the target work hours.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Single linear pass checks each element directly in optimal time.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: O(n) time and O(1) space with a single counter variable.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Write clean and succinct iteration using built-in counting or filtering primitives.
